summary: A static, light testimonials section on an off-white #fbfbfb page. Two faint vertical frame lines at x≈116 and x≈1135 run from the top to y≈498 and bound a central column; outside it, the top-left (x 0–112) and top-right (x 1138–1252) corners down to y≈58 carry a fine vertical pinstripe texture (light grey hairlines ~6 px apart), and the same pinstripe fills a band across the column under the cards (y≈420–498). A full-width hairline at y≈498 closes the section above a plain strip. Centred in the column is a two-line high-contrast serif heading, "A Few Words from / Happy Customers.", near-black navy (#041019), ~48 px, spanning x≈423–830, y≈65–158. A light grey hairline at y≈205 separates the heading from a three-column ruled grid (columns 116–457, 457–796, 796–1135, rows y 205–419) divided by thin vertical rules; each cell holds a grey sans-serif quote (~15 px, ~19.5 px line height, six or fewer lines from y≈228) and, at y≈388, a serif signature: name ~19 px dark plus a smaller serif state. Almost nothing moves over the 1.5 s: text, grid and stripes hold still (difference views show only compression shimmer on edges). The one real change is the hairline under the heading: at 0.2 s it runs the full column, touching both frame lines (x≈116–1135); between ≈0.85 s and 1.05 s it retracts from both ends so that by 1.25 s it spans only x≈128–1120, leaving ~12–15 px gaps at each frame line.

criteria.check: The page is a flat off-white (about #fbfbfb) with no gradient or shadow
First heading line reads exactly 'A Few Words from'
Second heading line reads exactly 'Happy Customers.' including the full stop
Heading is set in a high-contrast serif (bracketed serifs, thick/thin strokes), not sans-serif
Heading colour is near-black navy (about #041019), the darkest ink on the page
Heading is horizontally centred at x≈626, spanning about x 423–830, with cap tops near y 65 and baseline of line 2 near y 152
Heading cap height is about 34px (font size ~48px), two lines ~47px apart
A pale grey vertical hairline runs at x≈116 from the top edge down to y≈498
A pale grey vertical hairline runs at x≈1135 from the top edge down to y≈498
The region x 0–112, y 0–58 is filled with fine vertical light-grey pinstripes, and it is closed by a horizontal hairline at y≈58
The region x 1138–1252, y 0–58 has the same vertical pinstripes
Below the card grid, a band from y≈420 to 498 between the frame lines is filled with vertical pinstripes
Pinstripes are very low-contrast light grey hairlines (~1px) about 6px apart; they are straight, evenly spaced and never dark or bold
The pinstripe is only vertical lines: no diagonal hatching, no dots, no horizontal stripes inside the band
Areas between the pinstripes (beside the grid, x 0–112 below y 58 and x 1138–1252 below y 58) are plain off-white with no stripes
A full-width pale hairline crosses the frame at y≈498, with a plain strip below it to the bottom edge
A light grey (#ededed) 1px hairline lies at y≈205 under the heading, spanning the column
Exactly 3 testimonial cells sit side by side in one row
Thin pale vertical rules divide the cells at x≈457 and x≈796, running y≈205–419
A pale hairline at y≈419 closes the bottom of the grid, directly above the pinstripe band
Cells have no fill, no shadow and no rounded corners; they are defined only by hairline rules

Quote 1 reads '“We love BoomTax! We have used it for the last three years and they have been a real life saver when it comes to ACA compliance and reporting health coverage. Worth every one of 5 stars and then some!”' with curly quote marks

Quote 2 reads 'After careful research, we decided to go with the BoomTax ACA software solution for our ACA filing, and we had a flawless experience. Their online system is very user friendly and they are on top of the entire process. We highly recommend BoomTax!' with no quote marks

Quote 3 reads 'The customer support at Boomtax is magnificent, when you need to use it, which is hardly ever because the software works so smoothly. I highly recommend their solution to anyone who needs to comply with ACA reporting requirements.'
Quote text is a sans-serif at ~15px in medium grey (about #555–#666), clearly lighter than the heading and signatures
Quote first lines start at y≈230 and left edges sit at x≈138, 478 and 818 (about 22px inside each cell)
Quote 1 wraps to 5 lines, quotes 2 and 3 to 6 lines each, with ~19.5px line spacing
Signature 1 reads 'Linda G,' followed by 'Maryland'
Signature 2 reads 'Bianca P,' followed by 'Arizona'
Signature 3 reads 'Brian M,' followed by 'Illinois'
Names are serif ~19px in near-black; the state after the comma is a visibly smaller serif (~15px) on the same baseline
All three signatures share one baseline at y≈394, aligned with the quote left edges
At 0.2s the heading rule reaches both frame lines, running continuously from x≈116 to x≈1135
Between 0.2s and 1.25s the heading rule retracts from both ends: at 1.25s it spans only about x 128–1120, leaving ~12–15px gaps at each frame line
The rule holds full length through 0.7s and the retraction happens around 0.85–1.05s (at 1.0s the line shows breaks/partial segments)
Heading does not move, fade or change colour between 0.2s and 1.25s
Quote and signature text stay put with no fade, slide or reflow between 0.2s and 1.25s
The pinstripes do not scroll or shift sideways between 0.2s and 1.25s
Frame lines, column dividers and grid bottom rule stay fixed and full length between 0.2s and 1.25s
